name_note: Methanocatella is one of the genera created when the genus Methanobrevibacter was split; recent papers write the gut methanogen formerly called Methanobrevibacter smithii as Methanocatella smithii.

sentences.text: Methanocatella is one of eight new genera into which members of the genus Methanobrevibacter were reclassified, with the new names validly published.
The genus Methanobrevibacter, from which these genera were separated, consists almost exclusively of representatives from the intestinal tract of animals.
A comparative genomic study reported that this intestinal group evolved entirely in the digestive tract of animals and shows numerous adaptations to the copiotrophic gut environment.
That study also reported a decreased biosynthetic potential leading to dependence on other community members, which limits dispersal of these intestinal species into other habitats.

A genome catalog of the human gut archaeome reported Methanocatella smithii_Archaea1140 among disease-associated species, and described a Methanocatella smithii_A genome as an ulcerative colitis biomarker.
